title: Writing: Email Requests and Tone

escrever o mesmo pedido em versão formal e em versão informal, e fazer um follow-up sem parecer rude.
redigir dois e-mails com graus de formalidade adequados.
How would you ask your boss for a day off? And your best friend for a favor?
Have you ever sent an email and received no answer? What did you do?
Troque e fale (do informal ao formal):
Can you send me the file?
Could you send me the file?
Would you mind sending me the file?
I was wondering if you could send me the file.

questions.questionText: Which is the most formal request?

options.text: I was wondering if you could check my essay.

explanations.general: Correct answer: I was wondering if you could check my essay.

questions.questionText: I'm just ______ up on my previous email. (dando seguimento)

explanations.general: I'm just following up on my previous email.
I would greatly appreciate your help.

questions.questionText: Please reply whenever you have a ______. (oportunidade)

explanations.general: Please reply whenever you have a chance.

content.text: Quanto maior a distância (hierarquia), mais indireto o pedido.
do pedido — isso deixa o pedido mais aceitável.
Hope you're doing well! I missed Thursday's class because I was sick — could you send me your notes when you get a chance? No rush, anytime before Monday is fine.

I hope this email finds you well. I was unable to attend Thursday's lecture because I was ill. I was wondering if the slides from that class might be available, or if there is a reading I should complete to catch up.
Thank you very much for your understanding.
Follow-up (5 dias depois, para a professora):
I'm just following up on my email from last week about Thursday's lecture materials. I understand you're very busy, but I'd be grateful for any guidance on how to catch up before the quiz.

questions.questionText: Which email is appropriate for a professor?

options.text: Hey! Can u send the slides? Thx!
Dear Professor Nunes, I was wondering if the slides might be available.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Dear Professor Nunes, I was wondering if the slides might be available.

questions.questionText: Make it polite: “Why didn't you answer my email?”

options.text: I wanted to check whether you had a chance to look at my email.

explanations.general: Correct answer: I wanted to check whether you had a chance to look at my email.

questions.questionText: I hope this email ______ you well. (encontra)

explanations.general: I hope this email finds you well.

questions.questionText: Why is it good to explain the reason for your request?

options.text: It makes the request more reasonable and acceptable.

explanations.general: Correct answer: It makes the request more reasonable and acceptable.

questions.questionText: Would Tuesday ______ Wednesday work for you? (dar opções)

explanations.general: Would Tuesday or Wednesday work for you?

questions.questionText: An email to a friend that says “Dear Mr. Rafael, I would greatly appreciate…” is…

explanations.C: Não é grosseiro, é formal demais.

content.text: You want to ask Professor Kim for a recommendation letter for a scholarship. In your email: remind her who you are, explain what the letter is for, and say when you need it.
Your classmate Max hasn't sent his part of the group presentation, which is due in two days. Write him a friendly but clear follow-up.
O aluno lê os dois e-mails. O professor marca expressões com tom errado; o aluno troca na hora.
[ ] E-mail A: saudação/fechamento formais, pedido indireto, motivo e prazo claros?
[ ] E-mail B: tom amigável, mas pedido claro (prazo!)?
Escreva o mesmo pedido em 4 níveis de formalidade (5 pedidos diferentes).
Escreva um follow-up para o E-mail A (supondo que a professora não respondeu em uma semana).
Corrija os e-mails a) e b) da prática 4.3.
Grave pedidos orais para 3 pessoas diferentes (amigo, chefe, professor) — 20 s cada.
Write to the IT help desk: your laptop can't connect to campus Wi-Fi. Ask for help and suggest times you're available.
Write to a friend inviting them to a study session and asking them to bring something.

questions.questionText: Which is a polite follow-up opening?

options.text: I'm just following up on my previous email about the letter.

explanations.general: Correct answer: I'm just following up on my previous email about the letter.

questions.questionText: I'm sorry to ______ you again, but… (incomodar)

explanations.general: I'm sorry to bother you again, but…

questions.questionText: Best informal follow-up to a classmate?

options.text: Dear Mr. Max, I would be grateful if…
Hey Max, just checking in on your part of the slides — could you send it by tomorrow night?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Hey Max, just checking in on your part of the slides — could you send it by tomorrow night?

questions.questionText: I was wondering ______ you could write me a recommendation letter. (se)

explanations.general: I was wondering if you could write me a recommendation letter.
Correct answer: different words: agradecer/valorizar × adequado

questions.questionText: Giving options (e.g., two meeting times) makes it easier for the reader to reply.

content.text: 1 Could you please let me know when the grades will be available? 2 I was wondering if it would be possible to get an extension. 3 I wanted to check whether you had a chance to look at my email. 4 Could you tell me when the office opens?
a) informal demais para o reitor →
Dear Dean…, I'm writing to ask whether it would be possible to change my major…
b) formal demais para um amigo →
Hey Rafa, are you coming to the barbecue?
